---
name: Research workflow improvement
about: Propose a documented improvement to sources, templates, validator or workflow
labels: research, needs-triage
---

## What evidence gap or workflow failure did you encounter?

Describe the concrete object/job and where the current workflow broke. Do not name a third-party company unless the information is public and safe to discuss.

## What happened?

State the observed behavior, source class and why the current template/validator was insufficient.

## Proposed change

Explain the smallest change to workflow, template, reference or validator that would prevent the same failure.

## Privacy and provenance check

- [ ] I did not include personal data, credentials, private exports, customer messages or contact details.
- [ ] I identified the source class and the limitation of my evidence.
- [ ] I am not claiming PMF, revenue, demand or outcome without supporting evidence.
